prior_chapter_tail: The field was quiet. Seventeen graves. The sticks marking them. The flies.
timeline_position: February 1937 — Jarama front, south of Madrid

character_states.martin: in the trench at Jarama, wears pin on beret, holds crucifix at night, hears foreign voices
character_states.tomas: beside Martín in the trench, pragmatic, scapular on chest
character_states.padre_joaquin: hearing longer confessions, hands shaking during blessings
character_states.vidal: officer, clipped and factual, 'A field does not care which side you are on.'
